name: app-black-liquid-blob-tab-bar-on-phone-corner-over-purple
title: Black Liquid Blob Tab Bar on Phone Corner
whatItIs: A close crop of the bottom of a phone in dark chrome over a saturated purple background, its screen showing a light stock list with green sparklines and a black tab bar whose five icons sit in blobs that stretch and merge like liquid, the active home tab in a white icon inside a round bulge.
whatItMeans: A gooey merge between icons suggests movement between tabs, and black against a light list reads as a strong, tactile anchor.
techniques: Liquid blob shape joining tab icons
Active item bulge bigger than the rest
Tight crop on the phone corner
Saturated purple backdrop against a light UI
Green sparklines as the only colour in the list

vocabulary.definition: Shapes that stretch and merge as if made of liquid.
A swelling in a shape marking the active item.
A close crop on one corner of a device.
